```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [

]>
<config>&xxe;</config>
```

This would cause the parser to read arbitrary files from the server, perform SSRF attacks, or trigger DoS via entity expansion (Billion Laughs attack).

**Fix**: Disable DTD and external entity processing on the `SAXReader`.
